# dsh-token-ledger
Transparent, auditable token accounting for DeepSeek Harness.
English | 中文

> **This repository is a fork.** The original project is
> chenmiao8563/dsh-token-ledger,
> which pu

blished the plugin as `@chenmiao8563/dsh-token-ledger` up to v1.1.2.
> This fork continues that work

under `@zhz8888/dsh-token-ledger`, keeps the
> upstream's MIT notice in place and adds its own besi

de it, and carries the
> original as the `upstream` git remote. See License.

A ledger, not a dashboard. It folds the durable DSH session log into token totals,
keeps them restar

t-safe, and — the part that matters — lets you **recompute the
exact same numbers from the raw logs

and diff them** against what the running host
recorded.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

If you only want a pretty chart, there are a dozen plugins for that. This one is
for when you need t
o *defend* the number.

The settings page has four tabs — **Overview** (the ledger, with what each period
cost), **Rates** (

a price list for each vendor's models — the newest few by default,
all of them on request — with the

live USD/CNY rate), **Bill** (the same usage
turned into money — four groupings stacked over five p

eriods each) and **Backup**
(the ledger as a CSV or JSON file, and a MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL da

tabase
dumped to a .sql file) — and a CLI that works with no host running at all.

## Quick start
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or, with no host running at all — the CLI reads the raw session logs itself:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The ledger is written to `<DSH_HOME>/token-ledger/ledger.json`, and a fresh install
folds the histor

y already on disk rather than starting from today. It needs DSH
`^0.2.0-rc.1` (verified against `0.2

.1-rc.3`) and Node ≥ 22.15.0; everything else is
optional.
## Requirements
| | Requirement | Notes |
| **DSH** | `^0.2.0-rc.1` | Verified against `0.2.1-rc.3`. Load-bearing: DSH skips a plugin whose ra

nge excludes the running harness. See Compatibility. |
| **Node** | ≥ 22.15.0 | The CLI decodes Zsta

ndard frames. The host half needs nothing version-specific. |
| **Profile** | Any | The settings pag

e needs a profile with a web server (`web` or `desktop`); `/tokens` and the CLI work everywhere. |
|
**Network** | Optional | Only the price list and the USD/CNY rate are fetched. `rates: false` remov

es every request. |
| **Disk** | A writable `<DSH_HOME>/token-ledger/` | The only directory it write
s to, besides the exports you ask for. |
## Screenshots
The settings page's tabs, captured on a real ledger:
**Overview**, with the month's totals, today's usage and a year of activity:

**The calendar**, where a month's shape lives — busiest day, lightest day, the day
that ran latest —
above the same usage broken down by model:
**The last seven days** as bars, with the same by-model breakdown:
**Rates**: the live USD/CNY rate and each vendor's published price list:
## Why it installs where others do not
| Property | Why it matters |
| **Nothing is installed for you** | No runtime dependencies, and every declared peer is an optional
host package — so a version drift in a DSH package cannot pull a second copy of the harness into yo

ur profile. |
| **Zero install scripts** | `dsh plugin add` from a git URL works immediately — pnpm

has no build to block and no `allowBuilds` entry to add. |
| **Only `node:` imports** | The host hal

f loads from any profile (web, desktop, headless, TUI) without resolving a single package. |
| **No
model-facing surface** | It registers no prompt section, no message and no tool, so it cannot change

a request prefix or hurt KV-cache reuse. |
| **Fails soft** | Every hook is guarded. A ledger fault
logs a warning; it never fails a session. |
## What it deliberately does not do

- **The overview states an estimate with its basis; the bill itemizes it.** Both name
the price sour

ce, the rate they converted at, every price joined by name and every
model that could not be priced,

so the number can be checked rather than believed.
Neither is a provider invoice and neither claims

to be.
- **No bundled price list.** Prices are fetched from a source you can choose — the
default i

s each vendor's own list price — or typed by you. A price list shipped
inside the package would be w

rong within weeks and would have to be updated by a
release.
- **No model-facing tool.** A tool sche

ma costs prompt tokens on every request and
shifts the cache prefix — a strange thing for a token-ac

counting plugin to do.
`/tokens` and the CLI cover the human cases.
## Security

This plugin reads the session logs, reads `settings.yaml` for the provider display
names a bill show

s, and writes only inside `<DSH_HOME>/token-ledger/`. It reads no
provider credentials; the backup p

age keeps the **database passwords you type
yourself**, in that same directory, readable by your acc

ount only. The full list of
what it touches is in Permissions, item by item, so it can be
checked ag
ainst the source rather than taken on trust.

**To report a vulnerability, please do not open a public issue.** Use GitHub's
private reporting on

this repository's **Security** tab (*Report a vulnerability*),
which reaches the maintainer without

disclosing anything; if that option is not
available to you, contact the maintainer directly at the

address in
`package.json`.
